title: Slow or crashing computers
text: Takes ages to start, freezes, or keeps restarting? I'll find out why and get it running smoothly again.

title: Wi-Fi and internet
text: Wi-Fi is the wireless internet in your home. If it won't reach upstairs or keeps vanishing, I'll fix it.

ask: "I've had a scary message or phone call"
title: Scams and viruses
text: Worrying pop-up, odd email or a call claiming to be from Microsoft? I'll check everything is safe.

title: Printers
text: Says it's offline, or the laptop can't find it? I'll get it printing again and show you what to do next time.

ask: "I can't get iPlayer on the TV"
title: TVs and streaming
text: I'll set up iPlayer, Netflix or YouTube on your telly, and explain how the remote works.

ask: "I've got a new phone and don't know where to start"
title: New phones, tablets and laptops
text: I'll set it up, move your photos and contacts across, and show you the bits you'll actually use.

title: Passwords and email
text: Locked out of your email, or your Apple or Google account? I'll help you get back in, and keep your passwords safe.

ask: "I want to video call the grandchildren"
title: Video calls
text: FaceTime, WhatsApp or Zoom, set up so you can see the family with one tap.

title: Photos and backups
text: I'll find your photos, keep them safe, and set things up so they're never lost.
